title: Morning Brief — Saturday, 26 September 2026
description: Today: Sydney Water unions escalate industrial action over a bungled payroll system rollout; Queensland enjoys a warm spring weekend with a hazardous swell warning off the north coast; and the Gold Coast's weekend markets draw crowds to Carrara and HOTA. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made to listen to on the morning drive.
